rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and dated predictions before data; synthetic validation on 4 real skeletons (5 worlds x 100 replicates) plus a kick check, forcing a dated pre-data amendment (day-scale estimator replaced; P3/P4 operationalized; #44 plane rank); replication on 25 units x 3 vector variants (both models); natives G38, G44, G51, NE38; 417 estimates rows. Missing: reserved-period confirmation, full relaxation-matrix fit.
rationale.faithfulness: The easy-plane model fails: the kill fires in all variants (pooled rho_A 0.68 [0.50, 0.94] bge; 0.78 [0.60, 1.02] gte); the text plane is inside the random-plane band and has no extra day memory (variogram contrast -0.02 [-0.10, 0.06]). Isotropy (R-iso) wins; the hard-axis rival only weakly. Scorecard A1 B1 C0 D0 E0 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A clean, well-powered negative: goal and kickoff texts do not make their themes persist longer than other content; operators must restate goals to keep themes alive.

one_line: Agent content is not slower along the goal/kickoff/room text plane than across it (pooled rho_A 0.68 [0.50, 0.94], 25 units, kill fires); the plane is no slower than random planes and has no extra day-scale memory.

models.note: Anisotropic OU well with an easy text plane: rho_A within x3 of 1 (kill)
Easy-plane anisotropy set by the field texts: not seen at call or day scale
R-modes: the cross-fitted principal subspace is not slow either (pooled 0.72 [0.32, 1.60])

v2.claim: In 25 regime-III units of #37-#44 and #51, agent content decays along the goal/kickoff/room text plane at a rate within x3 of its rate across it (pooled rho_A 0.68 [0.50, 0.94], bge; gte 0.78 [0.60, 1.02]); the plane is no slower than random planes and has no extra day-scale memory
v2.scope: regime III, #37-#44 and #51 non-reserved units; natives G38, G44, G51, NE38
